intro: Arkansas Legislative Audit examines every county and publishes what it finds. This page quotes what the auditors reported about Little River County, from its latest report — no verdict added in either direction. What the auditors said is the record; what to make of it is yours.
regulatory_basis_note: Read this before reading any Arkansas audit: county and city reports carry a technical 'adverse opinion' on GAAP grounds because Arkansas law has them keep books on a simpler 'regulatory basis.' That phrase appears in every such audit in the state and signals the accounting format — not wrongdoing. A report is 'clean' or not in its findings, deficiencies, and noncompliance sections, which is what this page quotes.

verdicts.quote: During our evaluation, another issue came to our attention that would warrant disclosure in this report. Other Issue A check issued for $6,837 and mailed to a vendor was intercepted, altered, and subsequently cashed by an unknown individual. The bank discovered the altered check, and all funds were recovered from the bank.
verdicts.detail: A limited review (a “financial and compliance report”), not a full audit: the financial statements in it are unaudited.

limits: From the 2024 report, dated April 13, 2026. Read by machine from the report’s text; the quotes are the auditors’ words. Older reports, and the separate federal (single) audits, aren’t on this page yet.
Arkansas alternates between full audits and limited “financial and compliance” reviews; each line says which this is.
